Title: PlatformIO Development Documentation Page
Summary: Documentation page component for PlatformIO development support in Cyréna. Covers requirements, enforced feature-based project structure (src/ and include/ layouts, folder responsibilities), what Cyréna indexes (core + ESP-IDF), and getting started workflow.
Content:
## PlatformIO Development Page

**Route:** `/#/docs/platformio`
**Component:** `PlatformioDevelopmentComponent`
**Selector:** `app-platformio-development`

### Data Model

The component uses typed interfaces for all table and step data:

```typescript
interface Step {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

interface CoreLayoutEntry {
  item: string;
  content: string;
  access: string;
}

interface EspIdfEntry {
  item: string;
  content: string;
  access: string;
}

interface FolderResponsibility {
  folder: string;
  location: string;
  purpose: string;
}

interface FeatureFolder {
  name: string;
  description: string;
}
```

### Component Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `extensionId` | `string` | `'cyrena.platformio'` — the extension identifier |
| `prerequisites` | `string[]` | Three requirements: VS Code, PlatformIO extension, Cyréna extension |
| `srcLayout` | `FeatureFolder[]` | `src/` folder structure with feature folders, actions, internals |
| `includeLayout` | `FeatureFolder[]` | `include/` folder structure with public headers, definitions, actions, internals |
| `folderResponsibilities` | `FolderResponsibility[]` | Detailed responsibilities for each folder type |
| `coreLayout` | `CoreLayoutEntry[]` | Core project folders/files with access levels |
| `espIdfLayout` | `EspIdfEntry[]` | ESP-IDF-specific folders/files (all read-only) |
| `steps` | `Step[]` | 7-step getting started workflow |

### Page Sections

1. **Requirements** — VS Code, PlatformIO extension, Cyréna extension
2. **Enforced Project Structure** — Feature-based layout inside `src/` and `include/`
   - `src/` Layout table — main entry point, feature folders, actions, internals
   - `include/` Layout table — feature folders, public header, definitions, actions, internals
   - Folder Responsibilities table — definitions, actions, internals, feature header, feature source
   - Info alert: consumers include only `{feature}.h`
3. **What Cyréna Indexes**
   - Core Project Layout (Arduino & ESP-IDF) — src, include, lib, platformio.ini
   - Additional Folders for ESP-IDF — managed_components, components, sdkconfig*
4. **Getting Started** — 7 numbered steps
5. **Extension Reference** — extension ID callout

### src/ Layout

| Folder / File | Purpose |
|---------------|---------|
| `main.c / main.cpp` | Application entry point. |
| `{feature}/` | Feature folder containing feature source, actions, and internals. |
| `  {feature}.c / {feature}.cpp` | Feature initialisation or coordinator. Optional. |
| `  actions/` | Public action implementations. |
| `  internals/` | Private implementations. Never exposed outside the feature. |

### include/ Layout

| Folder / File | Purpose |
|---------------|---------|
| `{feature}/` | Feature folder containing public headers, definitions, actions, and internals. |
| `  {feature}.h` | The single public entry point for the feature. Consumers include only this file. |
| `  definitions/` | Types, structs, enums, and constants. Never in src/. |
| `  actions/` | Function declarations for public actions. |
| `  internals/` | Private headers. Never included from outside their own feature. |

### Folder Responsibilities

| Folder | Location | Purpose |
|--------|----------|---------|
| `definitions/` | `include/{feature}/` only | Types, structs, enums, and constants. Never in src/. |
| `actions/` | Both | Function declarations in include/, implementations in src/. |
| `internals/` | Both | Private headers in include/, private implementations in src/. Never exposed outside the feature. |
| `{feature}.h` | `include/{feature}/` | The single public entry point for the feature. Consumers include only this file. |
| `{feature}.c / {feature}.cpp` | `src/{feature}/` | Feature initialisation or coordinator. Optional. |

### Core Layout Table (What Cyréna Indexes)

| Item | Content | Access |
|------|---------|--------|
| `src` | Feature folders, main.c / main.cpp. | Read / write |
| `include` | Feature folders and their sub-folders. | Read / write |
| `lib` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h library files. | Read-only |
| `platformio.ini` | Project configuration file. | Read-only |

### ESP-IDF Additional Layout

| Item | Content | Access |
|------|---------|--------|
| `managed_components` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h files. | Read-only |
| `components` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h files. | Read-only |
| `sdkconfig*` | ESP-IDF configuration files. | Read-only |

### Access Badges
- `Read / write` → `badge bg-success`
- `Read-only` → `badge bg-secondary`

### Styling
- Light-themed tables with `#ffffff` background, `#212529` text
- Bootstrap `table-bordered` with `#dee2e6` borders
- Numbered step badges with `#0d6efd` background
- `alert-info` for note about feature header inclusion

### Route Registration
```typescript
{
  path: 'platformio',
  loadComponent: () => import('./features/docs/components/platformio-development/platformio-development.component')
    .then(m => m.PlatformioDevelopmentComponent)
}
```

### Architecture Notes
- Standalone component, no imports needed
- `OnPush` change detection
- All data is `readonly` class properties (no signals needed for static content)
- Uses `@for` with `track` expressions for all lists
- Self-contained template (no `DocPageBaseComponent` wrapper)
- `{feature}` placeholders in template use HTML entities (`{feature}`) to avoid Angular ICU message parsing errors
